yfinance.note: Primary for US/JP. Free, no key. May rate-limit. Same IP pool as yahoo_chart.

yahoo_chart.note: Yahoo Chart API v8. Same IP as yfinance — NOT independent. Different endpoint may have different availability.

finnhub.note: INDEPENDENT third-party. 60 calls/min free. Requires free API key (finnhub_api_key). True escape hatch from Yahoo rate limits.

alpha_vantage.note: US fallback. 25 calls/day, 5 calls/min. Free API key required (alpha_vantage_api_key).

efinance.note: Primary for A-shares/HK. Free, no key. East Money API — may block non-China IPs.

aktools.note: A-share fallback via Sina/Tencent sources. pip install akshare. No API key. Usually accessible from outside China.

stooq.note: PERMANENTLY DISABLED 2026-08-06 — stooq.com now requires JavaScript (Cloudflare Challenge). Replaced by finnhub (US) + aktools (A) + yahoo_chart.
